Third-party material in Stemma's citation formatter

citeproc-js 2.4.63 (npm package "citeproc"), Copyright (c) 2009-2019 Frank
Bennett. It is offered under either the Common Public Attribution License 1.0
or the GNU Affero General Public License; Stemma distributes it under the
Common Public Attribution License 1.0 (CPAL-1.0.txt). Its own notice is in
citeproc-js-LICENSE. It is included unmodified and unminified, as source code,
in dist/stemma.js. The same source is published at
https://registry.npmjs.org/citeproc/-/citeproc-2.4.63.tgz and
https://github.com/Juris-M/citeproc-js. The package names no Attribution
Information (CPAL Exhibit B), so CPAL section 14 asks for no display.

chicago-notes-bibliography.csl ("Chicago Manual of Style 18th edition (notes
and bibliography)", author Andrew Dunning and the contributors named in the
file) from https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles at commit
1aaf551f864d50e875a617b4faf2bf5da30f3f15, and locales-en-US.xml from
https://github.com/citation-style-language/locales at commit
938c09c164a60b3cfeabe61089f1bf4c3ea6a4ed. Both are licensed under the Creative
Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License (CC-BY-SA-3.0.txt). Both
are included unchanged; each file keeps its own credits and rights statement.
